verses.en: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.pt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,

verses.en: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:
verses.pt: Filho do homem, houve duas mulheres, filhas de uma mesma mãe,
verses.en_web: “Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.
verses.en_bbe: Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother:

verses.en: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.
verses.pt: Estas se prostituíram no Egito; em suas juventudes se prostituíram. Ali foram apertados os seus peitos, e ali foram apalpados os seios de sua virgindade.
verses.en_web: They played the prostitute in Egypt. They played the prostitute in their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their youthful nipples were caressed there.
verses.en_bbe: They were acting like loose women in Egypt; when they were young their behaviour was loose: there their breasts were crushed, even the points of their young breasts were crushed.

verses.en: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.
verses.pt: E seus nomes eram: Oolá, a maior, e Oolibá sua irmã; e elas foram minhas, e tiveram filhos e filhas. Estes eram seus nomes: Samaria é Oolá, e Jerusalém Oolibá.
verses.en_web: Their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.
verses.en_bbe: Their names were Oholah, the older, and Oholibah, her sister: and they became mine, and gave birth to sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem, Oholibah.

verses.en: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,
verses.pt: E Oolá prostituiu-se, mesmo sendo minha; e apaixonou-se por seus amantes, os assírios seus vizinhos,
verses.en_web: “Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,
verses.en_bbe: And Oholah was untrue to me when she was mine; she was full of desire for her lovers, even for the Assyrians, her neighbours,

verses.en: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
verses.pt: Vestidos de azul, governadores e príncipes, todos rapazes cobiçáveis, cavaleiros que andavam a cavalo.
verses.en_web: who were clothed with blue, governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.
verses.en_bbe: Who were clothed in blue, captains and rulers, all of them young men to be desired, horsemen seated on horses.

verses.en: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.
verses.pt: Assim ela cometeu suas prostituições com eles, os quais eram os mais apreciados dos filhos da Assíria, e com todos aqueles por quem ela se apaixonou; contaminou-se com todos os ídolos deles.
verses.en_web: She gave herself as a prostitute to them, all of them the choicest men of Assyria. She defiled herself with the idols of whoever she lusted after.
verses.en_bbe: And she gave her unclean love to them, all of them the noblest men of Assyria: and she made herself unclean with the images of all who were desired by her.

verses.en: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.
verses.pt: E não deixou suas fornicações que trouxe do Egito; pois com ela se deitaram em sua juventude, e eles apalparam os seios de sua virgindade, e derramaram sua prostituição sobre ela.
verses.en_web: She hasn’t left her prostitution since leaving Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her. They carressed her youthful nipples; and they poured out their prostitution on her.
verses.en_bbe: And she has not given up her loose ways from the time when she was in Egypt; for when she was young they were her lovers, and by them her young breasts were crushed, and they let loose on her their unclean desire.

verses.en: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
verses.pt: Por isso a entreguei na mão de seus amantes, na mão dos filhos da Assíria, por quem tinha se apaixonado.
verses.en_web: “Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, on whom she doted.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause I gave her up into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of the Assyrians on whom her desire was fixed.

verses.en: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.
verses.pt: Eles descobriram sua nudez, tomaram seus filhos e suas filhas, e a mataram à espada; e veio a ser famosa entre as mulheres, pois fizeram julgamentos contra ela.
verses.en_web: These uncovered her nakedness. They took her sons and her daughters; and they killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women; for they executed judgments on her.
verses.en_bbe: By these her shame was uncovered: they took her sons and daughters and put her to death with the sword: and she became a cause of wonder to women; for they gave her the punishment which was right.

verses.en: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.
verses.pt: Sua irmã Oolibá viu isso, porém corrompeu sua paixão mais que ela; e suas prostituições foram mais numerosas que as prostituições de sua irmã.
verses.en_web: “Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and in her prostitution which was more depraved than the prostitution of her sister.
verses.en_bbe: And her sister Oholibah saw this, but her desire was even more unmeasured, and her loose behaviour was worse than that of her sister.

verses.en: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.
verses.pt: Apaixonou-se pelos filhos da Assíria, pelos governadores e príncipes, seus vizinhos, vestidos com luxo, cavaleiros que andavam a cavalo, todos eles rapazes cobiçáveis.
verses.en_web: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers, her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men.
verses.en_bbe: She was full of desire for the Assyrians, captains and rulers, her neighbours, clothed in blue, horsemen going on horses, all of them young men to be desired.

verses.en: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,
verses.pt: E vi que ela estava contaminada; ambas tinham um mesmo caminho.
verses.en_web: I saw that she was defiled. They both went the same way.
verses.en_bbe: And I saw that she had become unclean; the two of them went the same way.

verses.en: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,
verses.pt: E ela aumentou suas prostituições; pois viu homens pintados na parede, as imagens de caldeus pintadas de vermelho,
verses.en_web: “She increased her prostitution; for she saw men portrayed on the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with red,
verses.en_bbe: And her loose behaviour became worse; for she saw men pictured on a wall, pictures of the Chaldaeans painted in bright red,

verses.en: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:
verses.pt: Vestidos com cintos ao redor de seus lombos, e enormes turbantes em suas cabeças, tendo todos eles aparência de capitães, à semelhança dos filhos da Babilônia, nascidos na terra da Caldeia.
verses.en_web: dressed with belts on their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like princes, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.
verses.en_bbe: With bands round their bodies and with head-dresses hanging round their heads, all of them looking like rulers, like the Babylonians, the land of whose birth is Chaldaea.

verses.en: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.
verses.pt: E apaixonou-se deles logo que seus olhos os viram, e enviou-lhes mensageiros à Caldeia.
verses.en_web: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them into Chaldea.
verses.en_bbe: And when she saw them she was full of desire for them, and sent servants to them in Chaldaea.

verses.en: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.
verses.pt: Então os filhos da Babilônia vieram até ela à cama dos amores, e a contaminaram com suas prostituições; e ela também se contaminou com eles; então sua alma desgostou deles.
verses.en_web: The Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their prostitution. She was polluted with them, and her soul was alienated from them.
verses.en_bbe: And the Babylonians came to her, into the bed of love, and made her unclean with their loose desire, and she became unclean with them, and her soul was turned from them.

verses.en: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.
verses.pt: Assim ela expôs suas prostituições, e expôs sua nudez; então minha alma desgostou dela, assim como já tinha desgostado de sua irmã.
verses.en_web: So she uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her nakedness. Then my soul was alienated from her, just like my soul was alienated from her sister.
verses.en_bbe: So her loose behaviour was clearly seen and her shame uncovered: then my soul was turned from her as it had been turned from her sister.

verses.en: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Porém ela multiplicou suas prostituições, relembrando-se dos dias de sua juventude, nos quais havia se prostituído na terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: Yet she multiplied her prostitution, remembering the days of her youth, in which she had played the prostitute in the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: But still she went on the more with her loose behaviour, keeping in mind the early days when she had been a loose woman in the land of Egypt.

verses.en: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
verses.pt: E apaixonou-se por seus amantes, cuja carne é como carne de asnos, e cujo fluxo é como fluxo de cavalos.
verses.en_web: She lusted after their lovers, whose flesh is as the flesh of donkeys, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
verses.en_bbe: And she was full of desire for her lovers, whose flesh is like the flesh of asses and whose seed is like the seed of horses.

verses.en: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.
verses.pt: Assim relembraste a obscenidade de tua juventude, quando os egípcios apalpavam teus peitos, por causa dos seios de tua juventude.
verses.en_web: Thus you called to memory the lewdness of your youth, in the caressing of your nipples by the Egyptians because of your youthful breasts.
verses.en_bbe: And she made the memory of the loose ways of her early years come back to mind, when her young breasts were crushed by the Egyptians.

verses.en: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;
verses.pt: Portanto, Oolibá, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu levantarei contra ti os teus amantes, dos quais tua alma desgostou, e eu os trarei contra ti ao redor:
verses.en_web: “Therefore, Oholibah, thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Behold, I will raise up your lovers against you, from whom your soul is alienated, and I will bring them against you on every side:
verses.en_bbe: For this cause, O Oholibah, this is what the Lord has said: See, I will make your lovers come up against you, even those from whom your soul is turned away in disgust; and I will make them come up against you on every side;

verses.en: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.
verses.pt: Os filhos da Babilônia, e todos os caldeus, Pecode, Soa, e Coa, todos os filhos da Assíria com eles; rapazes cobiçáveis, governadores e príncipes todos eles, capitães e líderes, todos os que andam a cavalo.
verses.en_web: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, and all the Assyrians with them; all of them desirable young men, governors and rulers, princes and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.
verses.en_bbe: The Babylonians and all the Chaldaeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: young men to be desired, captains and rulers all of them, and chiefs, her neighbours, all of them on horseback.

verses.en: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.
verses.pt: E virão sobre ti com armamentos, carruagens, carretas, e com ajuntamento de povos. Escudos grandes e pequenos, e capacetes serão postos contra ti ao redor; e eu os designarei para que façam o julgamento, e eles te julgarão conforme seus julgamentos.
verses.en_web: They will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples. They will set themselves against you with buckler, shield, and helmet all around. I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.
verses.en_bbe: And they will come against you from the north on horseback, with war-carriages and a great band of peoples; they will put themselves in order against you with breastplate and body-cover and metal head-dress round about you: and I will make them your judges, and they will give their decision against you as seems right to them.

verses.en: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.
verses.pt: E porei meu zelo contra ti, e te tratarão com furor; tirarão teu nariz e tuas orelhas, e o que restar de ti cairá a espada. Eles tomarão teus filhos e tuas filhas, e o que restar de ti será consumido pelo fogo.
verses.en_web: I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will take away your nose and your ears. Your remnant will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters; and the rest of you will be devoured by the fire.
verses.en_bbe: And my bitter feeling will be working against you, and they will take you in hand with passion; they will take away your nose and your ears, and the rest of you will be put to the sword: they will take your sons and daughters, and the rest of you will be burned up in the fire.

verses.en: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.
verses.pt: Também te despirão de tuas vestes, e tomarão as tuas belas joias.
verses.en_web: They will also strip you of your clothes, and take away your beautiful jewels.
verses.en_bbe: And they will take all your clothing off you and take away your ornaments.

verses.en: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.
verses.pt: Assim farei cessar de ti tua obscenidade e tua prostituição da terra do Egito; e não levantarás mais teus olhos a eles, nem te lembrarás mais do Egito.
verses.en_web: Thus I will make your lewdness to cease from you, and remove your prostitution from the land of Egypt; so that you will not lift up your eyes to them, nor remember Egypt any more.’
verses.en_bbe: So I will put an end to your evil ways and your loose behaviour which came from the land of Egypt: and your eyes will never be lifted up to them again, and you will have no more memory of Egypt.

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated:
verses.pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu te entregarei nas mãos daqueles a quem tu odeias, nas mãos daqueles dos quais tua alma se desgostou;
verses.en_web: “For thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Behold, I will deliver you into the hand of them whom you hate, into the hand of them from whom your soul is alienated.
verses.en_bbe: For this is what the Lord has said: See, I will give you up into the hands of those who are hated by you, into the hands of those from whom your soul is turned away in disgust:

verses.en: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
verses.pt: Eles te tratarão com ódio, e tomarão todo o ganho de teu trabalho, e te deixarão nua e despida; e será exposta a nudez de tuas prostituições, tua obscenidade, e tuas promiscuidades.
verses.en_web: They will deal with you in hatred, and will take away all your labor, and will leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, both your lewdness and your prostitution.
verses.en_bbe: And they will take you in hand with hate, and take away all the fruit of your work, and let you be unveiled and without clothing: and the shame of your loose behaviour will be uncovered, your evil designs and your loose ways.

verses.en: I will do these things unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen, and because thou art polluted with their idols.
verses.pt: Estas coisas serão feitas contigo porque te prostituíste atrás das nações, com as quais te contaminaste com seus ídolos.
verses.en_web: These things will be done to you, because you have played the prostitute after the nations, and because you are polluted with their idols.
verses.en_bbe: They will do these things to you because you have been untrue to me, and have gone after the nations, and have become unclean with their images.

verses.en: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.
verses.pt: Tu andaste no caminho de tua irmã; por isso darei o cálice dela em tua mão.
verses.en_web: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore will I give her cup into your hand.’
verses.en_bbe: You have gone in the way of your sister; and I will give her cup into your hand.

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou shalt drink of thy sister’s cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Tu beberás cálice fundo e largo de tua irmã; tu serás motivo de riso e escárnio, pois ele cabe muito.
verses.en_web: “Thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘You will drink of your sister’s cup, which is deep and large. You will be ridiculed and held in derision. It contains much.
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord has said: You will take a drink from your sister's cup, which is deep and wide: you will be laughed at and looked down on, more than you are able to undergo.

verses.en: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.
verses.pt: De embriaguez e de dor tu serás cheia; o cálice de tua irmã Samaria é cálice de medo e de desolação.
verses.en_web: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of your sister Samaria.
verses.en_bbe: You will be broken and full of sorrow, with the cup of wonder and destruction, with the cup of your sister Samaria.

verses.en: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.pt: Tu, pois, o beberás, o esvaziarás, e quebrarás seus cacos; e arrancarás teus peitos; porque eu falei,diz o Senhor DEUS.
verses.en_web: You will even drink it and drain it out. You will gnaw the broken pieces of it, and will tear your breasts; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And after drinking it and draining it out, you will take the last drops of it to the end, pulling off your breasts: for I have said it, says the Lord.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
verses.pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Dado que te esqueceste de mim, e me lançaste por trás de tuas costas, por isso, leva tu também as consequências de tua obscenidade e de tuas prostituições.
verses.en_web: “Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Because you have forgotten me, and cast me behind your back, therefore you also bear your lewdness and your prostitution.’”
verses.en_bbe: So this is what the Lord has said: Because you have not kept me in your memory, and because your back has been turned to me, you will even undergo the punishment of your evil designs and your loose ways.

verses.en: The LORD said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;
verses.pt: E disse-me o SENHOR: Filho do homem, julgarás tu a Oolá, e a Oolibá, e lhes denunciarás suas abominações?
verses.en_web: Yahweh said moreover to me: “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord said to me: Son of man, will you be the judge of Oholibah? then make clear to her the disgusting things she has done.

verses.en: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire, to devour them.
verses.pt: Pois elas cometeram adultério, e há sangue em suas mãos, e com seus ídolos cometeram adultério; e até a seus filhos que me haviam gerado fizeram passar pelo fogo, para os consumir.
verses.en_web: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have also caused their sons, whom they bore to me, to pass through the fire to them to be devoured.
verses.en_bbe: For she has been false to me, and blood is on her hands, and with her images she has been untrue; and more than this, she made her sons, whom she had by me, go through the fire to them to be burned up.

verses.en: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.
verses.pt: Ainda isto me fizeram: contaminaram meu santuário naquele mesmo dia, e profanaram meus sábados;
verses.en_web: Moreover this they have done to me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my Sabbaths.
verses.en_bbe: Further, this is what she has done to me: she has made my holy place unclean and has made my Sabbaths unclean.

verses.en: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.
verses.pt: Pois havendo sacrificado seus filhos a seus ídolos, vieram ao meu santuário no mesmo dia para profaná-lo; e eis que assim fizeram em meio da minha casa.
verses.en_web: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and behold, they have done this in the middle of my house.
verses.en_bbe: For when she had made an offering of her children to her images, she came into my holy place to make it unclean; see, this is what she has done inside my house.

verses.en: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,
verses.pt: E além disto, mandaram avisar a homens que viriam de longe, aos quais havia sido enviado mensageiro. E eis que vieram; e por causa deles te lavaste, pintaste os teus olhos, e te enfeitaste de joias;
verses.en_web: “Furthermore you sisters have sent for men who come from far away, to whom a messenger was sent, and behold, they came; for whom you washed yourself, painted your eyes, decorated yourself with ornaments,
verses.en_bbe: And she even sent for men to come from far away, to whom a servant was sent, and they came: for whom she was washing her body and painting her eyes and making herself fair with ornaments.

verses.en: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.
verses.pt: E te sentaste sobre uma cama luxuosa; diante da qual foi preparada uma mesa, e puseste sobre ela meu perfume e meu óleo.
verses.en_web: and sat on a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon you set my incense and my oil.
verses.en_bbe: And she took her seat on a great bed, with a table put ready before it on which she put my perfume and my oil.

verses.en: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
verses.pt: E ouviu-se nela voz de multidão alegre; e junto dos homens ordinários, foram trazidos os beberrões do deserto; e puseram braceletes em suas mãos, e belas coroas sobre suas cabeças.
verses.en_web: “The voice of a multitude being at ease was with her. With men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets on their hands, and beautiful crowns on their heads.
verses.en_bbe: ... and they put jewels on her hands and beautiful crowns on her head.

verses.en: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them?
verses.pt: Então eu disse à envelhecida em adultérios: Agora eles se prostituirão com ela, assim como ela faz.
verses.en_web: Then I said of her who was old in adulteries, ‘Now they will play the prostitute with her, and she with them.’
verses.en_bbe: Then I said ... now she will go on with her loose ways.

verses.en: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.
verses.pt: E se deitaram com ela como quem se deita com mulher prostituta; assim se deitaram com Oolá e com Oolibá, mulheres indecentes.
verses.en_web: They went in to her, as they go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.
verses.en_bbe: And they went in to her, as men go to a loose woman: so they went in to Oholibah, the loose woman.

verses.en: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
verses.pt: Por isso homens justos as julgarão pela lei que pune as adúlteras, e pela lei que pune as que derramam sangue; pois são adúlteras, e há sangue há nas mãos delas.
verses.en_web: Righteous men will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and with the judgment of women who shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
verses.en_bbe: And upright men will be her judges, judging her as false wives and women who take lives are judged; because she has been untrue to me and blood is on her hands.

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.
verses.pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Farei subir uma multidão contra elas, e as entregarei a terror e ao saque;
verses.en_web: “For thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘I will bring up a mob against them, and will give them to be tossed back and forth and robbed.
verses.en_bbe: For this is what the Lord has said: I will make a great meeting of the people come together against her, and will send on her shaking fear and take everything from her.

verses.en: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
verses.pt: E a multidão as apedrejará com pedras, e as cortarão com suas espadas; matarão seus filhos e suas filhas, e queimarão com fogo suas casas.
verses.en_web: The company will stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords. They will kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
verses.en_bbe: And the meeting, after stoning her with stones, will put an end to her with their swords; they will put her sons and daughters to death and have her house burned up with fire.

verses.en: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
verses.pt: Assim acabarei com a obscenidade da terra, para que todas as mulheres aprendam a não fazer conforme vossa obscenidade.
verses.en_web: “‘Thus I will cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to be lewd like you.
verses.en_bbe: And I will put an end to evil in all the land, teaching all women not to do as you have done.

verses.en: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
verses.pt: E porão sobre vós a culpa por vossa obscenidade, e levareis os pecados de vossos ídolos; e sabereis que eu sou o Senhor DEUS.
verses.en_web: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.’”
verses.en_bbe: And I will send on you the punishment of your evil ways, and you will be rewarded for your sins with your images: and you will be certain that I am the Lord.
